summary: Drafted prd/drafts/flow2-new-product-line.md for the studio's second flow -- creating a brand-new Shopify product (description, price, collection assignment, Draft-by-default status, and one initial variant) -- reusing v1's validated pic-edit and naming stations as two of three parallel legs, adding new description-generation and collection-suggestion legs behind one Block Kit approval card, with a fail-fast collision check inverted from v1 (an existing handle blocks creation instead of a missing id blocking a variant add). It stays decision-complete on architecture, scope boundaries versus v1, and safety defaults (Draft-not-Active on create, publish blocked on missing/invalid price, exactly one initial variant), while leaving seven genuinely open items in section 10 for the human decision walk: most urgent are OQ1 (how price is actually entered, which changes the happy-path action count and the card's Block Kit complexity) and OQ2 (the exact signal/grammar distinguishing 'create a new product' from v1's 'add a variant,' since getting this wrong risks silently misrouting a run); OQ3 (collection-suggestion mechanism), OQ4 (whether description-generation needs a naming-style validation pass before build), and OQ5 (the go-live mechanism for Draft products) are next most load-bearing.
